exact_prompt:
Edit this exact entire game diffuse UV canvas into a modest HD hand-painted texture. Reference is the full native64x64 stored RGB image enlarged NEAREST8x512x512. Return the full square canvas with exactly the same normalized UV positions, dimensions, contours, scale, dark gaps, original weak lightpatches and separate material fields. No crop, padding, framing, fitting, zoom, recentering, extra whitespace or layout changes.

Preserve the subdued charcoalgray matte softly painted cloth. Keep the large left rounded gray field, the original curved darker lower/outer field, EXACTLY ONE long narrow right gray strip with its weak source edgehighlight, and all the original angular graypaint fields at lower-left. Maintain their original soft/faint tonal folds and unequal lightstrength. Tiny existing pale marks at lower-left are original paint texture: do not interpret them as additional buttons, holes, rivets or stitched hardware.

Only softly resolve already present painted variation without new textile weave/threadgrain. Mostly flat gray areas stay mostly flat and smooth. Preserve each source dim highlight and dark broad shading instead of increasing local contrast or adding a hard raised rim. No invented seam, pleat, stitch, button, buckle, ring, border, crack, scratch, spot, glossy leather, metallic shine, bright white edge, text, badge, symbol, logo or decorative curl. The complete sourceUV must survive unchanged. Output opaque fullcanvas RGB; source alpha is restored separately.

source_transform_recipe.operations: Native stored RGBA→opaqueRGB, wholecanvas NEAREST8x. No crop/padding/rotate/UV fitting/unpremultiply/art inserted. SourceA separately restored by root.
source_transform_recipe.inverse: ENTIRE raw LANCZOS to original4x; sourceA LANCZOS separately; scalar brightness and original native Type handling by root.

prompt_serialization: Exact actual built-in prompt UTF-8 argument including CRLF equals prompt file bytes; references portable identities resolved against current repo root.
